description: How each weather model has verified at a resort over the trailing 90 days, graded against measured snow (SNOTEL depth change, clipped at zero), and what each model says for the next 7 days right now. Per model: rank, mean absolute error at day 1/3/7 (cm), bias ratio (total forecast over total measured; above 1 over-forecasts), samples, plus the current 7-day total and horizon. `truthBasis` and `measuredDays` say what the grading rested on; a resort with no measured series has no scores. The PeakCam blend is graded by the same rule and appears as `blend`.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: compare_models

license.description: Licence of the source data, e.g. `CC BY 4.0`.

text.description: The attribution line to carry with any reuse, e.g. `Weather data by Open-Meteo.com`.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

outlook.description: The newest stored run per model: what each says for the next 7 days.

scores.description: Ranked; empty until the scorer has measured days.

biasRatio.description: Sum(forecast) / sum(observed); above 1 means the model over-forecasts snow.

day1Mae.description: Mean absolute error of the day-1 snowfall forecast, cm.

rank.description: 1 = lowest day-1 MAE among the models scored at this resort (the blend is ranked too). Null before the first scoring run.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

title: Compare forecast models
